validity.recommendation: No action — existence, classification (trunk/transmission gas pipeline), and non-duplicate status all confirmed. Note the wiki page's own reference list mixes in sources about the neighboring Taldykorgan-Usharal project (P5901) — treat with care, see the linked spec concern.
validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE/CLASSIFICATION/DUPLICATE check. This is a real, operating trunk gas pipeline, independently confirmed by (1) KazTAG news agency (via online.zakon.kz mirror), 2012-09-29, reporting the construction launch ceremony for the 'Almaty-Taldykorgan' trunk gas pipeline in Almaty Region, quoting the region's akim (governor) and the implementing company TOO KATEK; (2) Kazakhstanskaya Pravda (state newspaper), 2018-04-02, describing the completed 'Almaty-Taldykorgan trunk gas pipeline, 264.8 km long' as the backbone that brought gas to Taldykorgan homes the prior year (2017); (3) Intergas Central Asia's own official asset list (intergas.kz 'General information' page), which names 'MG Almaty-Taldykorgan' as one of its operated trunk pipelines under UMG Almaty, SEPARATELY and DISTINCTLY from 'MG Taldykorgan-Usharal' in the same list. This directly refutes the roster's flagged duplicate concern vs P3964 (Taldykorgan-Usharal Gas Pipeline): the operator itself, and the Kazpravda article (which explicitly frames Taldykorgan-Usharal as the NEXT planned project after Almaty-Taldykorgan was already built), both treat these as two distinct, sequential physical pipelines, not one pipe under two names. PipelineType='transmission'/Fuel='Gas' is correct — Intergas classifies it as a MG (магистральный газопровод = trunk/transmission gas pipeline), not a gathering or distribution line. CAVEAT: several other citations on this pipeline's gem.wiki page (vlast.kz on 'Taldykorgan-Usharal', ecoportal.kz public hearing #10728 which is explicitly a hearing for 'Stroitelstvo gazoprovoda Taldykorgan-Usharal', and el.kz on the 'Saryozek-Taldykorgan' connection route) are actually about the SIBLING Taldykorgan-Usharal project, not this one — the gem.wiki page conflates a cluster of related regional gasification sub-projects. This citation contamination is very likely the root cause of the length defect flagged separately below.

validity.researcher_notes: SPEC check on LengthKnown=302.60 km. TWO independent primary/near-primary sources give a materially different figure for THIS pipeline's actual length: (1) KazTAG, 2012-09-29 (construction-launch article, quoting TOO KATEK, the implementing company): 'Obshchaya protyazhennost trassy do Taldykorgana sostavit 264,8 km' ('total route length to Taldykorgan will be 264.8 km'), routed through 7 districts of Almaty Region (Karasai, Zhambyl, Iliysky, Balkhash, Kerbulak, Koksu, Yeskeldy); (2) Kazakhstanskaya Pravda, 2018-04-02: 'Marshrut magistralnogo gazoprovoda Almaty-Taldykorgan protyazhennostyu 264,8 km' ('the route of the Almaty-Taldykorgan trunk gas pipeline, 264.8 km long'). Both sources — six years apart, different authors/institutions (a news wire vs a state newspaper), both citing named regional officials — independently agree on 264.8 km, not 302.60 km. This is corroborated by a THIRD, tier-2 source: GEM's own GulfPub crosswalk matches 'Almaty-Taldykorgan' at 263.93 km (within 1 km of the two primary sources) while separately matching 'Taldykorgan-Usharal' (P5901) at 302.56 km — i.e. GEM's own reference dataset already shows the two pipelines' true lengths are ~264 km and ~303 km respectively. P3964's current 302.60 km is essentially identical to P5901's true length (GEM records P5901 at 302.4 km), and the orchestrator's route-geometry check found GEM's drawn route for P3964 has almost no overlap with the GulfPub Almaty-Taldykorgan trace (IoU 0.018) while P5901's drawn route overlaps that source well (IoU 0.405) — consistent with a length value having been copied across rows (likely during original data entry, given how entangled the two projects' citations are on the shared gem.wiki cluster) while the route geometry itself was drawn correctly. SegmentCost=20,000,000,000 KZT IS independently confirmed by the same KazTAG article ('smetnaya stoimost gazoprovoda sostavlyaet okolo T20 mlrd' = 'estimated cost of the pipeline is about T20 billion') — so the cost field is fine, only length is wrong. ConstructionYear=2012 is directly confirmed (KazTAG dates the ground-breaking to 2012-09-29). StartYear1=2017 is corroborated indirectly: Kazpravda (published April 2018) describes 'last year's' (2017) arrival of gas to Taldykorgan homes as the region's headline event, and KazTAG's original 2012 plan targeted December 2014 completion — so there was a real multi-year slip from the original schedule to actual 2017 commissioning, which is a benign administrative delay, not a data conflict. Diameter (530 mm) and Capacity (0.15 bcm/y) could NOT be independently corroborated in this pass — no primary source located gives pipe diameter or throughput capacity for this specific line (the sources found describe route, districts, cost, and connection counts, not pipe specs); leaving these unresolved rather than fabricating support.

summary: P3964 confirmed real, correctly classified, and NOT a duplicate of P5901 (operator's own asset list + Kazpravda both treat Almaty-Taldykorgan and Taldykorgan-Usharal as distinct sequential pipelines); ConstructionYear/StartYear1/SegmentCost all corroborated. SPEC CONCERN staged: LengthKnown=302.60 km looks contaminated from sibling P5901 — two independent primary sources (KazTAG 2012, Kazpravda 2018) plus GulfPub agree on ~264-265 km instead. Diameter/Capacity unresolved (no independent source found either way).
